scope_notes: Both issuers publish complete quarterly consolidated statements: Q1, H1 and nine months, plus annual financial statements. Target coverage is H1 and 9M 2021, Q1/H1/9M 2022–2025 and Q1/H1 2026.
Quarter-one 2021 is superseded by H1 2021 before the September 2021 initial review; H1 includes the necessary same-period 2020 comparative for TTM reconstruction.

All five requested inputs are reported in each recovered interim. No quarterly sales-only trading updates, interpolation, proportional annual allocation or present-day revised XLS history is substituted.

Vestas 2022 rows supply contemporaneously observed restated FY2021 annual flow overrides to prevent mixed-policy TTM. Overrides do not change the original annual restoration dataset or historical annual availability.
Ørsted 2021 uses IFRS earnings, matching the previously recovered FY2020 IFRS annual figure. Net profit remains total group profit; CFO remains the reported operating cash-flow subtotal.

Ørsted 2024 net-versus-gross presentation changes affect revenue/cost of sales, not the requested profit and CFO totals. Other identified restatements concern FFO, financial ratios or sustainability metrics; these are not substituted for reported statements.
Full original PDFs and page text are preserved outside git; compact table and date excerpts are committed under sources/wind.
